jobs.how: Command each group with its On Off Setup BO and read back On Off State. Instances follow 01NNPP, so group 01 is 101xx and group 02 is 102xx. System Forced Off also has a collective (all groups) object.

points.use: Write Active = Run, Inactive = Stop
Read run status to confirm the command
Write Active = Execute to force this group off
Write Active = Execute to force all groups off

jobs.how: Write the mode to Operational Mode Setup and confirm it on Operational Mode State. Dry and Setback depend on BACnet Setting Tool / Initial Setting Tool options.

points.use: Write mode 1-6: Cool, Heat, Fan, Auto, Dry, Setback
Read the mode the group is actually in

jobs.how: Single-setpoint groups use Set Temp; dual-setpoint groups use Set Temp Cool and Set Temp Heat instead. Write only when the value changes: each property allows 24 writes per day.

points.use: Write single setpoint (set water temp on Air To Water)
Write cooling setpoint on dual-setpoint groups
Write heating setpoint on dual-setpoint groups
Write Auto-mode setpoint (single setpoint auto)
Write upper setback limit
Write lower setback limit

jobs.how: Read Room Temp for each group; on Air To Water groups the same point carries water temperature. Thermo On Off State shows the unit's thermostat on/off status.

points.use: Read room temp (water temp on Air To Water)

checklist: Register the BACnet connection license on the AE-C400 / EW-C50 so the controller can go ONLINE.
Connect the BMS to LAN2 on its own network and switch, separate from LAN1, using UDP 47808 and a Class C private address.
In the BACnet Setting Tool (one controller at a time) set the device number, protocol revision (Rev.12 for front ends at Rev.4-11), COV/event destinations and the objects in use.
Wait for the controller to show ONLINE, which can take up to about 10 minutes on large systems, then discover it from the BMS.
Read BI 10102 (On Off State), MI 10106 (Operational Mode State) and AI 10109 (Room Temp) for group 01 and compare them with the local remote; other groups follow 01NNPP.
Check whether each group is single or dual setpoint before mapping AV 10110 (Set Temp) or AV 10124 / AV 10125 (Set Temp Cool / Heat).
Test one write, such as BO 10101 (On Off Setup) to Run, and confirm it on BI 10102, leaving at least 200 ms between writes.
Set the BMS to write on change only, since each property allows 24 writes per day, and never rewrite on/off, setpoint, mode or prohibitions cyclically.
Map BI 10103 (Alarm Signal), MI 10104 (Error Code), AI 10149 (Error Code Detail) and BI 10120 (M-NET Communication State) as alarms for each group.
